caption: The drawing depicts a single pouch or bag with a gathered, yellow-green fabric at the top, cinched with a drawstring. Below the fabric section, the main body of the pouch features a vivid design dominated by a bright blue background. Triangular panels bordered with gold beading display green leafy vine motifs. The lower part of the pouch is decorated with patterns of multicolored flowers, including reds, blues, yellows, and greens, against a light background. The base of the pouch narrows, with the floral design wrapping around the lower edge. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there are small, handwritten notes and a name (“Ferdinand Sadler”) visible in the lower portion of the image.
title: Beaded Handbag
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
